acceptanceCriteria: A measured design with a format-gate decision for a smaller snapshot encoding, or a recorded decision that the current size is accepted for 1.0 with its bound.
body: Found 2026-10-20 by pre-1.0 lanes on origin/main 7d78a56b0 / a148e3a92, Corvint build 695, Darwin arm64, go1.27.3. V1-0328 lane measured 187,024,595 bytes per snapshot on an 11,733-file Corvint clone. Incremental reuse cut CPU but not bytes. Shrinking needs the invariant-7 benchmark/format gate.

title: Index snapshots are 187 MB per tree; shrinking them needs a format-gated encoding
